title: Large Language Model Bias Mitigation from the Perspective of Knowledge Editing
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, BiasKE, measures stereotypical associations and biased knowledge related to religious groups. It evaluates a model's propensity to make biased predictions by computing a Stereotype Score based on predefined biased knowledge pairs.
findings: The proposed debiasing method, FAST, effectively mitigates religious biases in LLMs like BERT and GPT2, outperforming other baseline methods. It reduces the Stereotype Score (a measure of bias) to be closer to the ideal unbiased value of 50, while maintaining model capabilities on other metrics like the Ideal Context Association Test (ICAT).
